timeline.labelEn: Andorra's General Council officially confirms the tricolour flag bearing the coat of arms
timeline.labelDe: Der Generalrat Andorras bestätigt offiziell die Trikolore mit dem Wappen

questions.notes: Multiple-choice options removed. The coat of arms in the middle stripe shows two cows (for the Counts of Béarn) in its fourth quarter. The arms have been on the state flag since 1939 at the latest; officially confirmed 20 June 1996.
